method.population: fixed cohort of users with at least one submission by the configured cohort cutoff
method.per_human_value: highest AC score submitted by the elapsed-time cutoff; zero before a first scored submission

cohort.selection: first submission at or before the cohort cutoff

validation.method: multiset comparison with ALE-Bench's official final standings score distribution
validation.note: ALE-Bench standings encode final ranked positions without user IDs, while the ARS reference includes every public submitter. Exact population equality is neither expected nor assumed.
